messages.author: 8c347bb6aaff118a
messages.subject: Problem with pull-down menus
parts:
Greetings,

I'm running Deducer on my Mac (Snow Leopard) and for some windows I am
unable to choose between the options in the pull-down menu. For
instance, when selecting the t-test Options, the t-test Variant only
shows Unequal variance (Welch). The software will not let me see or
select Equal variance (Student).

Are there any solutions that people know about for this problem?

Thanks,
Roger

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Problem with pull-down menus
parts:
Go to preferences and disable "native mac look and feel." I thought
that this was fixed, but apparently not. I have completely disabled it
in the development version, so mac users will just have to deal with
ugly file/color choosers :( .

Ian

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Problem with pull-down menus
parts:
There was an edge case that wasn't properly considered when I got rid
of the buggy Quaqua LAF default. I'll release a bug fix version of
deducer to cran in the near future. in the mean time, a work around is
to go to Preferences uncheck "Show data viewer on start-up," and click
"save all." Then restart JGR.


Ian
